children: may bounce moderately into $103.66-$103.95 per barrel, before retesting a support at $102.18.
A wave c from $107.81 has briefly travelled below its 100% projection level of $102.76. It is likely to extend into the range of $99.65-$100.84 formed by the 161.8% and the 138.2% levels.
A break above $103.95 may lead to a gain into the range of $104.69-$105.14. On the daily chart, the market remains within the lower channel, despite its effort to climb toward the upper channel.
Both the lower channel and the wave pattern suggest a drop toward $98. A break above $105.88 would confirm the extension of the uptrend toward $110.24-$114.92 range.
